scientific_integrity.claim_scope: One individually coloured root, all other vertices initially equal, finite Cartesian products of complete graphs of sizes at least two; exact internal refinement partitions and root-preserving orbits.
limitations: No claim for noncomplete factors or multiple marked vertices
Known binary and two-factor boundaries overlap established cases
Bounded novelty search cannot rule out specialized prior results
scientific_integrity.verification: Full proof and two independently implemented finite partition-checking programs, outputs embedded; finite checks not substituted for infinite proof.

title: Exact one-root colour-refinement wavefronts for mixed Hamming graphs
